review: 701.14c: the skip claimed no Forge card can make a creature fight itself, but Nightfall Predator ('fights target creature', any creature) can target itself; removed the skip and added 701.14c-1 (Nightfall Predator with Holy Strength so that only twice its power is lethal).

scenarios.title: Each fighting creature deals damage equal to its power to the other
decisions: A casts Prey Upon targeting Centaur Courser (creature A controls) and Grizzly Bears (creature A does not control), tapping Forest.
Both players pass; Prey Upon resolves.

variants.label: courser_vs_bears
variants.expected: Centaur Courser (3/3) deals 3 damage to Grizzly Bears (2/2) and Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to Centaur Courser. Grizzly Bears is destroyed and moves to B's graveyard. Centaur Courser stays on the battlefield with 2 damage marked. No player's life total changes.

variants.label: craw_wurm
variants.delta: B's creature is Craw Wurm (6/4) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Centaur Courser deals 3 damage to Craw Wurm and Craw Wurm deals 6 damage to Centaur Courser. Centaur Courser is destroyed and moves to A's graveyard. Craw Wurm stays on the battlefield with 3 damage marked.

variants.label: zero_power
variants.delta: A's creature is Wall of Wood (0/3) instead of Centaur Courser.
variants.expected: Wall of Wood deals 0 damage to Grizzly Bears, which stays on the battlefield undamaged. Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to Wall of Wood, which stays on the battlefield with 2 damage marked.

scenarios.title: If either fighting creature is an illegal target on resolution, neither deals damage
decisions: A casts Prey Upon targeting Centaur Courser and Grizzly Bears, tapping Forest.
A passes priority; B casts Lightning Bolt targeting Centaur Courser, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Lightning Bolt resolves.
Both players pass; Prey Upon resolves.

variants.label: own_creature_bolted
variants.expected: Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage to Centaur Courser, which is destroyed and moves to A's graveyard before Prey Upon resolves. Prey Upon resolves with one illegal target: Grizzly Bears fights nothing, takes no damage and stays on the battlefield undamaged.

variants.label: no_response
variants.delta: B does not cast Lightning Bolt; both players pass with Prey Upon on the stack.
variants.expected: Both targets are legal on resolution. Centaur Courser deals 3 damage to Grizzly Bears, which is destroyed. Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to Centaur Courser, which stays on the battlefield with 2 damage marked.

variants.label: shock_response
variants.delta: B casts Shock instead of Lightning Bolt targeting Centaur Courser.
variants.expected: Shock deals 2 damage to Centaur Courser, which survives with 2 damage and stays a legal target. Prey Upon resolves normally: Centaur Courser deals 3 damage to Grizzly Bears, which is destroyed, and Grizzly Bears deals 2 more damage to Centaur Courser (4 total), which is destroyed. Both creatures are in their owners' graveyards.

variants.label: opposing_creature_bolted
variants.delta: B casts Lightning Bolt targeting B's own Grizzly Bears instead of Centaur Courser.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is destroyed and moves to B's graveyard before Prey Upon resolves. Prey Upon resolves with one illegal target: Centaur Courser fights nothing, takes no damage and stays on the battlefield undamaged.

scenarios.title: Fight damage is not combat damage and is not prevented by a combat-damage prevention effect

setup.notes: Fog is cast and resolved first, so the prevention effect applies for the rest of the turn.

decisions: A casts Fog, tapping Forest; both players pass; Fog resolves.
A casts Prey Upon targeting Centaur Courser and Grizzly Bears, tapping the second Forest.
Both players pass; Prey Upon resolves.

variants.label: fight_after_fog
variants.expected: Fog's prevention applies only to combat damage, so the fight damage is dealt: Centaur Courser deals 3 damage to Grizzly Bears, which is destroyed, and Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to Centaur Courser, which stays with 2 damage marked.

variants.label: combat_after_fog
variants.delta: A does not cast Prey Upon; A attacks with Centaur Courser and B blocks with Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: The combat damage that would be dealt between Centaur Courser and Grizzly Bears is prevented. Both creatures stay on the battlefield with no damage marked.

scenarios.title: A creature that fights itself deals damage to itself equal to twice its power

setup.notes: Nightfall Predator is the transformed back face of Daybreak Ranger (4/4, '{R}, {T}: Nightfall Predator fights target creature.'). Holy Strength makes it 5/6, so damage equal to its power once (5) would not be lethal but twice its power (10) is.

decisions: A activates Nightfall Predator's ability, tapping Mountain and Nightfall Predator, targeting Nightfall Predator itself.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: fights_itself
variants.expected: Nightfall Predator (5/6) deals 10 damage to itself and is destroyed in the next state-based check; it moves to A's graveyard and Holy Strength moves to A's graveyard. Grizzly Bears is undamaged.

variants.label: fights_bears
variants.delta: A targets Grizzly Bears instead of Nightfall Predator.
variants.expected: Nightfall Predator deals 5 damage to Grizzly Bears, which is destroyed and moves to B's graveyard. Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to Nightfall Predator, which stays on the battlefield with 2 damage marked.

scenarios.forge_notes: FightEffect.dealDamage deals twice the power when both fighters are the same card. The setup needs Daybreak Ranger already transformed.
